title: Decision Speed V1 · Flaps 20°
description: Source-backed V1 lookup for the standard Learjet 35A/36A 20° takeoff-flap configuration.
notes: The source table states the tabulated takeoff data were determined for dry runway, zero wind, zero runway gradient, anti-ice off and anti-skid on.
Anti-ice ON V1 is not encoded in this dataset and must not fall through to the anti-ice OFF source grid.
Sparse high/hot source regions are intentionally absent. Requests requiring an unavailable source corner fail closed rather than extrapolating or using a nearest row.
Intermediate values use bounded linear software interpolation only when every required source corner exists.

sources.note: Bombardier Crew Checklist & Quick Reference Handbook · April 2001
